brief.topic: Two Arches and One Quiet Landing

s01: A fountain can send water along two different arches and land in the same place.
The taller arch does not always reach further.
Imagine each drop leaving at the same speed, with air resistance set aside.
Gravity changes the upward motion, while the sideways motion stays steady.
A steeper launch buys more time in the air, but gives away sideways speed.
At thirty degrees, the drop travels low and wide.
At sixty degrees, it climbs higher and stays aloft longer.
Both drops return to the starting height at the same horizontal distance.
For this ideal model, range follows the sine of twice the launch angle.
Thirty and sixty degrees give the same value.
The symmetry belongs to equal launch speeds and equal landing heights.
Now turn the nozzle halfway between them, to forty-five degrees.
The landing point moves a little further out.
Here the balance of sideways speed and time gives the greatest range.
A fountain offers more than one way to reach the same place, and one angle that reaches furthest.

scenes.narration:
A fountain can send water along two different arches and land in the same place. The taller arch does not always reach further.

Imagine each drop leaving at the same speed, with air resistance set aside. Gravity changes the upward motion, while the sideways motion stays steady. A steeper launch buys more time in the air, but gives away sideways speed.

At thirty degrees, the drop travels low and wide. At sixty degrees, it climbs higher and stays aloft longer. Those two changes balance exactly. Both drops return to the starting height at the same horizontal distance.

For this ideal model, range follows the sine of twice the launch angle. Thirty and sixty degrees give the same value. The symmetry belongs to equal launch speeds and equal landing heights.

Now turn the nozzle halfway between them, to forty-five degrees. The landing point moves a little further out. Here the balance of sideways speed and time gives the greatest range. A fountain offers more than one way to reach the same place, and one angle that reaches furthest.
